snippet.title: SZKELETAL: Estrogen Dracul's Potato Hunger 🥔🧛‍♂️ | STEAM EDITION trailer | Summer Game Fest 2026 E3
snippet.description:
SZKELETAL is not just a game. It's an interactive monument erected to Polish "ludology", our beloved industry "gaming experts", and other online "pathologies"—and at the same time, a highly satirical slap in the face to the flash game Skeletal: Deadly Shuffle.

And hey, if you don't know any of these Polish internet micro-celebrities or obscure lore—honestly, good for your mental health. Even if the inside jokes fly right over your head, you can still perfectly enjoy the core gameplay. Underneath the layers of local satire lies a highly addictive bullet-heaven loop, and the game will be available in dozens of languages. You don't need a degree in Eastern European memes to have a great time grinding enemies into potato mash.

You play as Kiszczak - a tragic figure reduced by chronic potato hunger to the form of Count Drakul. The goal of this existential drama is trivially simple: don't get smashed by the incoming hordes and, with a smile on your bones, grind the whole lot into delicious, steaming potatoes. Standing in your way will be the embodiments of internet sages, streamers, and YouTube talking heads, who will try to interrupt your starchy feeding frenzy at all costs.

This algorithm-fueled indie slop, being yet another Vampire Survivors clone, has been cobbled together for months by a single, desperate man who, in an act of creative madness, employed a whole orchestra of generative AI tools to help him. You can actually taste this absolute jank today for free on itch.io, but keep in mind that it's an old, rickety mess. The true, polished experience is heading straight for STEAM, and the trailer above is just a foretaste of the impending disaster.

If this charming circus intrigues you in any way, I encourage you to toss a coin or at least follow the project. On launch day, the game will deplete your wallets by an amount equivalent to a large bag of chips or a bottle of cheap bum wine.

Crucial info and useful links:
- 🚂 STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4754300 - The game's store page is now available, where you can officially add this banger to your Wishlist.
- 💀 itch.io: https://wypok.itch.io/szkeletal - Here you can touch the old game build for free. It lacks many new features from the upcoming Steam edition, but it serves as an excellent chronicle of this slop's creation.
- 🪙 Gamefound: https://gamefound.com/en/projects/wypok-games/umieszczenie-gry-szkeletal-na-platformie-steam - here can you throw some pennies at the development of this little game and secure a prestigious spot in the virtual graveyard for yourself (or your favorite mother-in-law). Greetings for your mom in the game's code are also on the table.
- 🥔 Dev Logs: https://wykop.pl/tag/szkeletal - If you have a bit of masochism in you and are interested in the development process of this slop, I irregularly dump updates from the battlefield under this wykop tag.
